values.claim: totSize is initialized to mov->current_top_box_start, and if mov->bytes_removed is nonzero, totSize is reduced by mov->bytes_removed (with an assertion that totSize >= mov->bytes_removed).
totSize is incremented by a->size for each parsed top-level box in the MOOV, META, MDAT, FTYP, OTYP, PDIN, STYP/SIDX/SSIX, MOOF, and default/unknown cases.
mov->current_top_box_start is set to the current bitstream position plus mov->bytes_removed before parsing each top-level box and again after each box.
values.evidence:
L26: mov->current_top_box_start = gf_bs_get_position(mov->movieFileMap->bs) + mov->bytes_removed;
L445: mov->current_top_box_start = gf_bs_get_position(mov->movieFileMap->bs) + mov->bytes_removed;

values.claim: For the first MDAT box, mov->first_data_toplevel_offset is set to mov->current_top_box_start and mov->first_data_toplevel_size is set to a->size.

For STYP/SIDX/SSIX boxes when mov->moov exists and no first data toplevel offset is set, mov->first_data_toplevel_offset is set to mov->current_top_box_start and mov->first_data_toplevel_size is set to a->size.
mov->main_sidx_end_pos is set to mov->current_top_box_start plus a->size for a SIDX box when mov->NextMoofNumber is zero.
mov->sidx_start_offset is set to mov->current_top_box_start for a SIDX box in signal-frag-bounds mode.
mov->sidx_end_offset is set to the current bitstream position for a SIDX box in signal-frag-bounds mode.
mov->styp_start_offset is set to mov->current_top_box_start for a STYP box in signal-frag-bounds mode.
mov->original_moov_offset is set to mov->current_top_box_start when a MOOV box is parsed.
mov->original_meta_offset is set to mov->current_top_box_start when a META box is parsed.
For an unknown box with original_4cc GF_ISOM_BOX_TYPE_JP, c is set to box->data and the four bytes c[0..3] are read only when box->dataSize equals 4.
In GF_ISOM_OPEN_KEEP_FRAGMENTS mode, mov->NextMoofNumber is set to mov->moof->mfhd->sequence_number plus 1.
In single_moof_mode, mov->single_moof_state is incremented for each MOOF box, and parsing returns GF_OK when it exceeds 1.
When mov->moov exists, mov->interleavingTime is set to mov->moov->mvhd->timeScale.
In GF_ISOM_OPEN_READ mode with signal_frag_bounds and not read-debug, mdat_end is set to the current bitstream position after an MDAT box.
